dashboard.guideTitle: Yggdrasil Minecraft Login Quick Start Guide

guide.apiMissing: The administrator has not configured the API public domain. Please contact the administrator.
guide.step1Desc: Go to Character Management to create your game character. Each character has its own Yggdrasil Token.
guide.step2Desc: View and copy the character's Yggdrasil Token in Character Management. It will be used as the Minecraft login password.
guide.step3Desc: Add a custom Yggdrasil authentication server in your Minecraft launcher and enter the following address:
guide.step4Desc: In the launcher, use the character name as the username and the Yggdrasil Token as the password to log in.
guide.tip1: The location of the custom authentication server setting varies between launchers. Please refer to your launcher's documentation.
guide.tip2: A leaked Token may allow others to impersonate your character. Please keep it safe.
guide.tip3: If your Token is leaked, you can regenerate it in Character Management.

permRisk.title: High-Risk Permission
permRisk.body: This permission allows the creation or modification of administrator accounts and their permission groups. Holders can elevate themselves or others to an all-powerful account essentially equivalent to root, thereby gaining full control over the entire admin panel. Grant it only to fully trusted administrators, and never enable it carelessly.

security.title: Security Settings
security.intro1: Ling Yggdrasil offers rich security customization, solving the problem of having a good machine yet not being able to fully utilize its performance while worrying about insufficient security: since you have a more powerful server, why not use a more powerful encryption system?
security.intro2: Note: Raising this parameter may cause the server to crash due to insufficient performance, or worse, make account authentication impossible and prevent logging into the admin panel. It is recommended to test thoroughly in a non-production environment before use.
security.desc1: A basic encryption security level balancing security and performance, with extremely low machine performance overhead
security.desc2: An enhanced encryption security level with higher security and relatively higher machine performance overhead than electromagnetic encryption
security.desc3: Introduces titanium crystals to further improve the security factor, but also demands higher server performance
security.desc4: Introduces particle broadband, controlling particles to maintain a certain regularity, but places higher demands on server performance
security.desc5: Introduces exotic matter and quantum computing, achieving a certain unification of quantum field theory and general relativity. Security is extremely high and requires very strong server performance.
security.desc6: Combines the power of electromagnetism, energy, structure, information, and gravity, catalyzed by antimatter. It is the ultimate crystallization of the theory of everything, with security that is nearly invincible, requiring an extraordinarily powerful server.
security.perfWarning: Extremely high server performance overhead and very high configuration requirements!
